_instructions: Setting descriptors for the configuration composer (see config/configuration/settings-catalog.json). Current values are always read live; descriptors hold no defaults.

settings.description: How many times a tool call the tool worker never took is tried again before the agent is told it did not start; 0 turns retrying off.
examples: wait longer for the tool worker after a restart
tools fail while the worker restarts

settings.description: Milliseconds before the first retry of a tool call the tool worker never took; each later retry waits twice as long, at most 30 seconds.
examples: space out retries to the tool worker
first retry after half a second

settings.description: Seconds the tool worker remembers a finished call's result, so a lost answer can be asked for again instead of running the call twice.
examples: keep tool results longer in the worker
how long a lost tool answer can be recovered

settings.description: Most finished tool calls the tool worker remembers at once; the oldest are forgotten first and running calls always stay.
examples: remember more tool calls in the worker
limit how many results the worker keeps

settings.description: Largest single tool result, in bytes, the tool worker remembers; a larger one cannot be asked for again if its answer is lost.
examples: do not keep large results in the worker

settings.description: Most bytes of remembered tool results the tool worker keeps in memory in all; past it the oldest are forgotten.
examples: let the worker use less memory for results
